title: Intro to Git and GitHub
line: Save work in commits, branch, merge and share it on GitHub.

project.title: A film list with a merged pull request
project.brief: Start a new repository alone for a list of your favorite films. Make at least four commits, ignore .DS_Store, add one section on a branch and merge it through a pull request on GitHub.
checks: The GitHub repository has at least four commits on main
One merged pull request came from a separate branch
A .gitignore is committed and git status reports a clean working tree

lessons.title: Set up Git and make a repository
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner Git in the macOS Terminal. Set user.name and user.email with git config, make a cookbook folder, run git init -b main inside it and read git status.
lessons.passes: cookbook is a Git repository on a branch named main and user.name is set.

lessons.title: Stage and commit
lessons.goal: Teach the Git working tree, the staging area and commits by writing pancakes.md in the cookbook, staging it with git add and saving it with git commit -m.
lessons.passes: The repository has one commit and it adds pancakes.md.

lessons.title: See what changed with log and diff
lessons.goal: Teach git diff, git diff --staged and git log --oneline by changing the pancake recipe in the cookbook twice and committing each change with a clear message.
lessons.passes: git log shows three commits and git status reports a clean working tree.

lessons.title: Undo a change and ignore files
lessons.goal: Teach git restore, git restore --staged and .gitignore by throwing away a bad edit to pancakes.md, unstaging a file and keeping .DS_Store out of the cookbook for good.
lessons.passes: .gitignore lists .DS_Store and is committed, and pancakes.md matches the last commit.

lessons.title: Work on a branch
lessons.goal: Teach Git branches with git switch -c and git branch by adding waffles.md to the cookbook on a branch named add-waffles while main stays as it was.
lessons.passes: The add-waffles branch has one commit that main does not have.

lessons.title: Merge a branch
lessons.goal: Teach git merge and reading git log --oneline --graph by merging add-waffles into main in the cookbook and deleting the branch once it is merged.
lessons.passes: main holds waffles.md and the add-waffles branch no longer exists.

lessons.title: Fix a merge conflict
lessons.goal: Teach resolving a Git merge conflict. Change the same line of pancakes.md on main and on a branch, merge, read the conflict markers, choose the final text and commit the merge.
lessons.passes: The last commit has two parents and no file holds conflict markers.

lessons.title: Connect to GitHub with an SSH key
lessons.goal: Teach connecting Git on a Mac to GitHub. Make an ed25519 key with ssh-keygen, add the public key to the GitHub account and test the link with ssh -T git@github.com.
lessons.passes: ssh -T git@github.com greets the learner by their GitHub user name.

lessons.title: Push the cookbook to GitHub
lessons.goal: Teach Git remotes by making an empty repository on GitHub, linking it with git remote add origin and sending the cookbook up with git push -u origin main.
lessons.passes: origin points at GitHub and origin/main matches the local main branch.

lessons.title: Open a pull request
lessons.goal: Teach the GitHub pull request flow. Push a branch that adds syrup.md to the cookbook, open a pull request on github.com, read the diff, merge it and update main with git pull.
lessons.passes: The GitHub repository has one merged pull request and local main holds its commits.
